parameters.name: HealthStatus
parameters.description:
The health status of an ECS instance. Valid values:

*   Healthy
*   Unhealthy

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of an ECS instance in a scaling group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess set-instance-health --instance-id i-bp1ap6bro51a7fsa0000 --health-status Healthy --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
